vocabularies.definition: The standard abbreviations (pick-list codes) of AGS 4.2.0 for headings of data type PA, one collection per heading. Only entries with status Approved, Accepted, Deprecated are included.
creator: https://www.ags.org.uk/

vocabularies.definition: The standard abbreviations (pick-list codes) of AGS 4.2.0 for headings of data type PA, one collection per heading. Only entries with status Approved, Accepted, Deprecated are included.
creator: https://www.ags.org.uk/

vocabularies.definition: Codes for chemical contaminants and determinands used in ELRG_CODE (AGS 4.1 onwards) and ERES_CODE (AGS 4.0). Only entries with status Approved, Accepted, Deprecated are included.
creator: https://www.ags.org.uk/

vocabularies.definition: The data TYPEs of AGS 4.2.0. Generic types such as nDP are top concepts; the specific types used in the dictionary (e.g. 2DP) are narrower concepts.
creator: https://www.ags.org.uk/

vocabularies.definition: The GROUPs and HEADINGs of the AGS 4.2.0 data dictionary (Electronic Transfer of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Data). Groups are top concepts and each heading is a narrower concept of every group it appears in. Group categories are collections.
creator: https://www.ags.org.uk/

vocabularies.definition: The rules of the AGS 4.2.0 data format. Sub-rules (e.g. 10a) are narrower than their main rule (10).
creator: https://www.ags.org.uk/

vocabularies.definition: The standard units of measurement of AGS 4.2.0 (UNIT group), grouped by quantity type. Only entries with status Approved, Accepted, Deprecated are included.
creator: https://www.ags.org.uk/
